layoutAuthority: Keep current homepage/system structure; only replace/polish the right-side hero visual.

hero.right.bird.notes: Main golden Lac bird. Preserve aspect ratio. This is the focal point. Do not redraw or substitute.

hero.right.dongson.notes: Faded Dong Son drum background behind the bird. Keep subtle.

hero.right.wave.notes: Golden ribbon/wave anchored to the bottom-right. Never cover hero text or CTA.

hero.right.sparkles.notes: Soft sparkle/glow overlay. Decorative only; keep restrained.

rules: Badge, H1, description, CTA and USP remain real HTML/UI, never baked into image assets.
Do not change sidebar/topbar/hero content order or the surrounding dashboard information architecture.
Do not redraw, generate, search for or substitute any of these four assets.
Right visual area should be about 38-42% of hero width on wide desktop.
On mobile reduce decorative opacity/scale before sacrificing text readability.
Decorative images must use empty alt text and aria-hidden because they convey no unique content.
